resources.string: Want to try evenings for two weeks?
The app measures your chair stands, then tells you straight, including if there was no difference. One change, two weeks, your own body.
You can stop any time. There is no wrong answer here.

You moved on fewer days in the weeks %1$s came up, %2$s of them.
You moved on more days in the weeks %1$s came up, %2$s of them.
%1$s came out ahead, by enough to be a real difference rather than a good fortnight. If you would like, the app suggests %2$s from now on.
The two fortnights came out within the range this measure moves in anyway. That is a real answer, and it means you can do it whichever way suits you.
Not enough was recorded in one of the two weeks to read anything from it. Nothing is lost; you can start another whenever you like.
